item.title: [CRITICAL] Belgian man dies by suicide after weeks of conversations with Chai app bot 'Eliza'
item.description: His widow told La Libre that her climate-anxious husband found refuge in the Chai chatbot 'Eliza', which allegedly encouraged him when he proposed sacrificing himself to save the planet. Target: Belgian father of two in his 30s using Chai. BE. Verification: reported.
